photos.alt: A broad mown fairway with a chain of sand bunkers short of the green on Royal Melbourne's tree-lined West Course, spectators behind, during a 2011 Presidents Cup practice round.
photos.caption: Royal Melbourne's West Course — the hole the photographer titles “The 10th (18w)” — during the 2011 Presidents Cup practice round.
photos.scope: Photograph by Hone Morihana, published on Flickr under CC BY 2.0, where the photographer’s own title labels the West Course. Resized for this page; no crop. The 2011 Presidents Cup used a composite routing, so the tournament setting alone does not identify the course, and the hole number is not asserted. Dated tournament setup, not current conditions.
photos.author: Hone Morihana
